info.name: GenAI & RAG API (Course)
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Week 3 AM: Generative AI, Embeddings, ChromaDB, RAG, and Evaluation. Start stack with scripts/setup.sh first.

request.description: Checks API liveness, ChromaDB heartbeat, and OpenAI API key status.
Splits text into Byte-Pair Encoded tokens and returns token IDs, pieces, and count.
Demonstrates whitespace and indentation preservation in code tokenization.
Generates 1536-dimensional dense vector embeddings using text-embedding-3-small.

body.raw:
{
  "text": "# Meridian Solutions Remote Work Policy

## Eligibility
Employees who have completed 90 days of continuous employment may request a hybrid or fully remote arrangement.

## Equipment Reimbursement
Meridian provides a one-time $500 home office stipend for ergonomic chairs, monitors, and peripherals.",
  "strategy": "recursive",
  "chunk_size": 120,

request.description: Splits text respecting structural boundaries (paragraphs, headings, newlines).
Splits text strictly every N characters without linguistic boundary checks.
Groups complete sentences until the chunk size threshold is reached.
Lists all documents currently indexed in ChromaDB.
Chunks, embeds, and stores a new document into ChromaDB.
Removes a document and all its embedded chunks from ChromaDB.
Embeds query and performs top-k cosine similarity nearest neighbor search.
Queries IT security rules and returns relevant chunk excerpts with distance scores.
Executes full RAG pipeline: retrieval, context injection, synthesis, and citation extraction.
Tests system abstention when context lacks answers to prevent hallucination.
Runs LLM-as-a-judge to score faithfulness (groundedness) and answer relevance on a 0.0-1.0 scale.
